name: support-ops
description: Run a customer support queue on numbers from a helpdesk ticket export. Three deterministic stdlib scripts: an SLA check that measures first-response and resolution attainment on business or calendar hours with holidays, counts open breaches as misses and lists tickets due next; a staffing planner using Erlang C for phone and chat (service level, ASA, occupancy cap, shrinkage, chat concurrency) and workload with backlog drain for email, with the roster gap per interval; and a deflection finder that ranks contact reasons and routes each to a help-center article, a macro or a product fix. Ships cs-support-ops-lead agent, /cs-support-sla, /cs-support-staffing and /cs-support-deflection commands and 3 cited references.
